claim: Microsoft's fiscal Q2 2026 R&D expense topped $9.2 billion for the first time.
summary: The claim concerns Microsoft fiscal Q2 2026 (quarter ending Dec 31, 2025) R&D exceeding $9.2B for the first time. That quarter had not been reported as of the Jan 4, 2026 cutoff, so neither the value nor the first-time aspect can be established from prior knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft's fiscal Q2 2026 R&D expense topped $9.2 billion
sub_claims.note: Fiscal Q2 2026 ends Dec 31, 2025 and would normally be reported late Jan 2026, after the Jan 4 2026 knowledge cutoff, so the value cannot be established from existing knowledge.

sub_claims.text: It was the first time Microsoft's quarterly R&D expense exceeded $9.2 billion
sub_claims.note: Whether any prior quarter exceeded $9.2 billion and whether Q2 2026 was the first to do so cannot be established without Q2 2026 results, which post-date the knowledge cutoff.
